Command.Comment: RAGIN CORE openssl and path inventory

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo FILELIST
find /etc /opt /app /root /home -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null \
  | sed -E 's#^/(etc|opt|app|root|home)/([^/]+)/.*#/\1/\2#' \
  | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 40
echo SSL_ETC
ls -la /etc/ssl 2>/dev/null || true
ls -la /etc/ssl/certs /etc/ssl/private 2>/dev/null || true
echo OPENSSL_CERTS_ETC
find /etc/ssl -maxdepth 4 -type f \
  \( -name '*.pem' -o -name '*.crt' -o -name '*.key' -o -name '*.cert' \) \
  2>/dev/null | head -n 80
echo OPENSSL_RAGIN
find / -type d -iname '*ragin*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 40
echo OPENSSL_HOMEDIR
find /home /root -maxdepth 4 -type f \
  \( -name '*.pem' -o -name '*.crt' -o -name '*.key' -o -name '*.cert' \) \
  2>/dev/null | head -n 80
echo OPENSSL_CONFIG
find /etc/ssl /etc/pki -maxdepth 4 -type f -name 'openssl.cnf' 2>/dev/null | head -n 10 || true
echo DONE
